name: Godrick Farsan
summary: Godrick Farsan is an undead warlock assistant located in the Undercity, serving alongside Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter. Despite being entirely blind, he says that he sees in a different way.

sections.title: Eyes in the Dark
sections.body: Situated amidst the summoning circles of the Magic Quarter, Godrick Farsan aids Master Carendin Halgar in guiding aspiring Forsaken warlocks. Though he lacks physical sight, Godrick says he can still see in a different way, without explaining the means. He tests practitioners seeking to bind greater demonic entities, dispatching them to gather pure hearts and essences needed for intricate summoning rituals.

faq.answer: Godrick Farsan is a Forsaken warlock stationed in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. He serves as an assistant to Master Carendin Halgar, aiding in the instruction and rituals of fledgling warlocks.

faq.q: How can Godrick see if he is blind?
faq.answer: Godrick says that he sees in a different way despite his blindness. The precise means are not explained.

faq.q: Is Godrick related to Strahad Farsan?
faq.answer: They share a surname, but no family connection is confirmed.

faq.q: What role does he play in warlock training?
faq.answer: Godrick helps oversee the binding rites for warlocks, specifically guiding them through tasks such as acquiring pure hearts to lure and bind a succubus.

angles.text: Forsaken warlocks looking to master the art of summoning a succubus must consult Godrick to prepare the necessary lures and understand the devouring nature of demonic servants.
Godrick exemplifies the Forsaken warlock philosophy, embracing physical ruin and blindness while honing dark magical awareness to replace mortal frailties.
